synopsis: Patrick Jane joins Teresa Lisbon's CBI unit as a consultant, demonstrating his uncanny abilities to read human behavior while hunting for clues about the serial killer Red John.
Jane faces scrutiny from internal affairs and a new boss, Madeleine Hightower, while Red John strikes closer than ever, culminating in a chilling face-to-face encounter.
Hightower is framed for murder by a Red John mole within CBI. Jane orchestrates an elaborate sting operation in a shopping mall food court to trap and confront his nemesis.
Jane is tried for murder after shooting the decoy Red John and acquitted. He stages a complete psychological breakdown in Las Vegas to lure the real killer into the open.
Jane narrows the suspect list of Red John down to seven high-ranking officials and suspects, only to discover Red John has anticipated his exact list.
The definitive showdown: Jane unmasks Red John as Sheriff Thomas McAllister and exacts his revenge. Two years later, Jane is recruited by the FBI in Austin, Texas.
Working cases with the FBI in Austin, Patrick Jane and Teresa Lisbon navigate their blossoming romantic relationship, culminating in a beautiful wedding and a peaceful new chapter.
